pagerduty: [ALERT] Service=runtime-serving · High p99 latency · PD-789 fired (severity: high) :rotating_light:
inc-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-789 triggered at 2026-07-18T14:20:34Z — paging on-call (aj).
aj: ack — saw the page, jumping in. Can someone drop the last span from traces?
maria: grabbing traces now. looks like a spike in `generate` RPCs to model `redwood-7b-quant` with long context (~12k tokens).
sam: checking autoscaler state — Dedicated pool reports no new workers spun up in the last 3m. No infra errors in the logs.
aj: ok, did PD show any error counts or just latency?
pagerduty: PD-789 details — symptom: p99 > 800ms, affected routes: /v1/generate (hosted), 2% reqs at spike peak, no 5xx rise.
maria: traces attached: ```
span_id: 0x7f3c
op: runtime.execute
latency_ms: 1234
kv_cache_hits: 0
input_tokens: 11800
```
jules: hmm no KV cache hits for these requests, looks like cold KV flows. Were these from a new canary or internal test?
ops-shift: noticed a load generator job `ci-load/checkpoint-regen` rotated at 14:18 UTC, possibly overlapping.
aj: try soft-fallback to smaller model variant on route. Sam, can you flip routing policy to prefer `redwood-7b-quant-fast`?
sam: initiating routing override to variant `-fast` for the next 2m. command: `infra route set-priority runtime-serving /v1/generate redwood-7b-quant-fast 1 --ttl 120s`
inc-bot: Routing override applied by sam.
aj: sending a quick hotfix — change route weights to 80/20 favoring fast variant.
maria: confirming from traces — p99 dropped to ~420ms within 40s of the override.
pagerduty: PD-789 auto-resolved at 2026-07-18T14:22:58Z (alert duration ~144s).
aj: marking as auto-resolved. No customer 5xxs, small % of requests saw degraded latency, but overall SLO unaffected.
jules: reaction :thumbsup: good catch. We should still log this as a flapping noise: cause likely internal load test + cold KV cache.
ops-shift: noted — I've filed a followup ticket infra#3421 to add a pre-warm step for `ci-load/checkpoint-regen` and to rate-limit it during peak hours.
maria: also adding a short-lived KV prefill for long-context requests to avoid cold misses; patch queued.
aj: handoff: I'm wrapping up but will stay available for 10m in case of re-trigger. Oncall next (maria) — you good to pick up?
maria: taking handoff, will monitor for 15m.
sam: logging timeline + quick mitigations in incident notes.
inc-bot: Incident summary draft — PD-789: transient p99 latency spike due to internal load job causing cold KV cache and shortfall in autoscale responsiveness. Mitigation: routing override to faster model variant; auto-resolved. Impact: minor latency increase for ~2% requests; no customer-facing errors. Followups: infra#3421, runtime#558.
aj: ok closing thread here, will include timestamps in post-incident review. :white_check_mark:
